newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek shares end down, surprising mutual funds.
newsitem.headline: Greek shares end down, surprising mutual funds.

text.p: Greek equities closed 1.30 percent down in moderate to low turnover. Fund managers were surprised by the drop, saying lack of fresh inflows and taxation worries could be the explanation.

"It is surprising to me that the benchmark fell so much today," said Apostolos Constandinidis, fund manager at Hambros Hellenic Mutual Funds. "Lack of liquidity and worries about taxation issues might explain the drop."
He said turnover was low and many shares yielded ground to light selling.
The Athens general share index closed down 1.30 percent, or 12.41 points at 941.70 from Monday's 954.11 close after opening at 953.49 points.
Turnover was at 6.74 billion drachmas on volume of 5.10 million shares boosted by a block trade of 205,000 shares in Keranis and 50,000 shares in Delta Diary.
